[[Phi's Wisdom]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[wand]] dropped by [[Arcane Ancient Phi]], a [[boss]] who can be found in [[Raisu Palace|Raisu Palace (mission)]] and [[Raisu Palace (explorable area)]].

==Stats==
:[[Chaos damage]]: 11-22 (Requires 9 [[Domination Magic]])
:Halves casting time of [[Fast Casting]] [[spell]]s (Chance: 20%)
:Halves skill recharge of Fast Casting spells (Chance: 20%)

==Replica==
This item cannot be replicated. Inscription and wand wrapping would result in HCT and HSR of [[Domination Magic]] instead of [[Fast Casting]].
